governed_construct: Every binding name the code itself declares for a variable or function: identifiers bound by var/let/const declarators (including every name bound inside object/array destructuring patterns, for-loop and for-of/in heads), names of function declarations, generator/async function declarations and named function expressions, function/arrow/method parameters (including destructured parameter bindings), and catch-clause parameters. Not governed: object property keys, class/interface/type/enum names and enum members, class method and property names, and imported bindings.
interpretation: A declared variable or function name conforms if it is camelCase: after stripping any leading underscores or dollar signs it starts with a lowercase letter and contains no underscores or hyphens (digits and further capital letters are allowed, e.g. userId, parseHtml2). snake_case (retry_count), PascalCase (GetUserName) and any lowercase name containing an underscore violate. One edge exception follows the common constant convention: a const binding written entirely in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE (DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS) is accepted as a constant, not a violation. Names that are not declared by the code (property keys like first_name in an object literal, type fields, names that only appear in strings or comments) are not instances, so snake_case there does not violate. A file whose only declarations are types, interfaces and enums is NOT_APPLICABLE. A file is SATISFIED if it declares at least one governed binding and all conform, VIOLATED if any one does not.
